messages.一撃で流れを変えるパワーファイター。: A power fighter who can turn a fight with a single punch.
messages.ストレートの先に、咲かせる一撃: A new punch blooms beyond the straight
messages.サンドバッグで拳を重くしながら、スパーリングも数回はさんで形を整える。: Build punching power on the heavy bag, with a few sparring sessions to refine your form.
messages.（かつては自分も、ボクサーとしてリングに立っていた。今はコーチとして、選手を支え: (I used to step into the ring as a boxer myself. Now I'm a coach, supporting someone else's fight.)
messages.は？ あんたがあたしのトレーナー？ ……まあいいわ。: Huh? You're my trainer? ...Fine, I guess.
messages.言っとくけど、あたしは誰にも負けない。せいぜい足を引っ張らないでよね。: Just so we're clear, I'm not losing to anyone. Try not to hold me back.
messages.（……負けず嫌いだな。でも、目はちゃんと本気だ）: (...She really hates losing. But I can see how serious she is.)
messages.…何よ、その顔。ふん、結果で黙らせてあげる。見てなさい！: ...What's that look for? Hmph. I'll let my results shut you up. Just watch!
messages.望むところだ。試合は4週ごとに1つ。認定戦を二つ勝ち抜いて、ジムの代表として花冠: That's what I want to hear. One fight every four weeks. Let's win both qualifying bouts, represent the gym, and go for the Flower Crown title.
messages.第1認定戦の相手はジムの新人だ。まずはこの公式戦で、挑戦候補としての実力を示そう: Your first qualifier is against the gym's rookie. This is an official bout—your chance to prove you're a contender.
messages.同じジムだからって、手加減はしないわ。まずはあたしが本物だって証明してあげる。: I'm not going easy just because we're from the same gym. I'll show them I'm the real deal.
messages.（同じジムなら、手の内はお互い知っている。差がつくのは、この4週間の仕上げだ）: (We train at the same gym, so we both know each other's game. These four weeks of preparation will make the difference.)
messages.最終認定戦の相手、椿の資料だ。ここに勝てば、ジムの推薦で花冠王座へ挑める。: Here's the file on Tsubaki, your final qualifier. Win this and you can challenge for the Flower Crown title with the gym's backing.
messages.……ふん。見なくたって、あいつの顔くらい覚えてるわよ。代表の枠も、あたしが取る。: ...Hmph. I don't need a picture to remember her face. That spot is mine, too.
messages.（そう言って紙を受け取る指が、少しだけ冷たい。……でも、目は逸らしていない）: (Her fingers are a little cold as she takes the paper. ...But she doesn't look away.)
messages.花冠王座を持つ現チャンピオンの資料だ。……数字だけ見れば、認定戦の二人とは格が違: Here's the reigning Flower Crown champion's file. ...On paper, she's in a different league from your two qualifying opponents.
messages.……手、震えてないわよ。ちょっと、握りが強いだけ。: ...My hands aren't shaking. I'm just gripping a little harder.
messages.でもね、燃えてるの。ジム代表のあたしの拳で、王座を奪ってみせるんだから。: But I'm fired up. I'll represent this gym and take that title with my own fists.
messages.四週間だ。王者相手にも、お前のパンチを通せる形に仕上げるぞ。: Four weeks. We'll get your punches ready to break through even the champion's defense.
messages.……ふん、当たり前でしょ。あたしの拳で、あの王者を倒してやるわ。: ...Hmph. Obviously. I'll knock that champion down with my own fists.
messages.（握りは強いままだった。……震える代わりに握ってる。昔から、そういうやつだ）: (Her grip stays tight. ...She clenches her hands instead of letting them shake. She's always been like that.)
messages.……ねえ。次のメニューも、あんたが決めて。: ...Hey. You pick the next training session, too.
messages.珍しいな。「試合はあたしが決める」って言ってなかったか。: That's new. Didn't you say the fight was yours to decide?
messages.決めるわよ、試合は。……練習は、あんたのほうが分かってるでしょ。昔から。: It is. The fight, I mean. ...You know more about training. You always have.
messages.（言い方はきついが、預けてくれた。まずは、そこからだ）: (She says it sharply, but she's trusting me with this. That's a start.)
messages.はぁ…はぁ…っ、まだ、いける…！: Hah... hah... I can... keep going...!
messages.……休んでると、つい次の試合のこと考えちゃうのよね。: ...Whenever I rest, I end up thinking about the next fight.
messages.無理はするな。少し休もう。: Don't push yourself. Let's take a break.
messages.今は焦らなくていい。体を休めるのも準備だ。: There's no need to rush. Resting is part of getting ready.
messages.……分かってる。あんたが見てるなら、ちゃんと休むわ。: ...I know. If you're watching, I'll actually rest.
messages.次の組み立てを考えよう。ストレートからフックへつなぐ形はどうだ。: Let's think about your next combination. How about a straight into a hook?
messages.……それも昔のやつに混ぜとくわ。まずストレート。とにかくストレートよ。: ...I'll work that into the old stuff, too. Straight first. Always the straight.
messages.（聞いていない訳じゃない。何を渡しても、全部あのストレートの強化に変換されていく: (It's not that she isn't listening. Whatever I give her, she turns it into another way to strengthen that straight.)
messages.あいつには、あのストレートで勝たなきゃいけないの。あんたに貰った、あれで。: I have to beat her with that straight. The one you gave me.
messages.……うるさいわね。ほら、次の試合の話、続けるわよ！: ...Oh, shut up. Come on, let's keep talking about the next fight!
messages.……なあ。前の氷室戦のあと。ロッカールームにいたの、知ってる。: ...Listen. After your last fight with Himuro. I know you were in the locker room.
messages.あのとき、あたし、完璧にやったつもりだった。あんたに貰ったストレート、一発も無駄: I thought I'd done everything perfectly. That straight you taught me—I didn't waste a single one. And it still wasn't enough.
messages.だから返せてないのよ、まだ。あんたが現役の時間を割いて、あたしにくれたもの。あん: So I haven't paid you back yet. You took time out of your own career to teach me. What I've done isn't even close to enough.
messages.あれは貸しじゃない。当時のお前に一番効く武器を渡した。それだけだ。: It wasn't a loan. I gave you the weapon that suited you best back then. That's all.
messages.……あんたはそう言うでしょうね。でも、あたしが決めるの。返し方も、返す量も。: ...Of course you'd say that. But I get to decide how I repay you. And how much.
messages.ストレートは仕上がってる。でも、椿にはそれだけじゃ足りない。……今日は、まだ作っ: Your straight is ready. But that alone won't beat Tsubaki. ...Today, we'll build a punch you don't have yet.
messages.ストレートは仕上がってる。でも、椿にはそれだけじゃ足りない。……今日は、その先の: Your straight is ready. But that alone won't beat Tsubaki. ...Today, I'll explain the punch that comes next.
messages.……は？ 何それ。あたしのストレートに、文句あるわけ？: ...Huh? What's that supposed to mean? Got a problem with my straight?
messages.ない。だから、その先を作る。アッパーだ。……ほら、構えろ。腰を落として、下から突: No. That's why we're building on it. An uppercut. ...Come on, take your stance. Lower your hips and drive upward.
messages.ない。だから、その先を作る。アッパーだ。体は休めたままでいい。腰を落として、下か: No. That's why we're building on it. An uppercut. You can keep resting. Imagine lowering your hips and driving upward.
messages.……腰を落として、下から。すぐに打つの？: ...Hips down, then up from below. Do I throw it right away?
messages.速い。速すぎる。一回ためろ。……返したい分、全部そこに乗せてこい。: Too fast. Much too fast. Load up for a moment. ...Put everything you want to give back into it.
messages.一回ためる。……返したい分、全部そこに乗せるつもりで。: Load up for a moment. ...Imagine putting everything you want to give back into it.
messages.……っ、うるさい！ ためてから、一気に突き上げる。そうでしょ！: ...Oh, shut up! Load up, then drive straight upward. Right?!
messages.……っ！ 今の……今の感触、覚えた。……ねえ、これ。あんたのじゃなくて、あたした: ...! That... I've got it. I know how it feels now. ...Hey. This one's ours, right? Not just yours.
messages.……分かった。次に拳を出すとき、確かめるわ。……ねえ、これ。あんたのじゃなくて、: ...Got it. I'll check it next time I throw a punch. ...Hey. This one's ours, right? Not just yours.
messages.王者の映像、今日で三本目だ。……お前のストレート、もう研究されてると思え。: That's our third video of the champion today. ...Assume she's already studied your straight.
messages.読まれてても通すのがストレートよ。……でもね。: A straight gets through even when they see it coming. ...But you know what?
messages.今のあたしには、あんたと考えてきた戦い方もあるんだから。: Now I've also got the way of fighting we worked out together.
messages.なら、それをどう当てるかだ。王者相手にも通せる形にする。: Then we need to work out how to land it. Make it work against the champion, too.
messages.……上等。あたしの拳で、あの王者を倒してやる。: ...Fine by me. I'll bring that champion down with my own fists.
messages.……ねえ。試合の日。セコンド、ちゃんとあんたが付くのよね。: ...Hey. On fight day. You'll be in my corner, right?
messages.当たり前だ。他に誰がいる。: Of course. Who else would it be?
messages.……別に。確認しただけ。あんたが横にいないと調子出ないとか、そういうんじゃないか: ...Nothing. Just checking. It's not like I can't get going without you beside me or anything.
messages.（そういうんだ、と言ったら、ミットが飛んでくる）: (If I say, "So that's exactly it," a mitt will come flying at me.)
messages.……椿、言ってた。読めてたって。読めてて、一手遅れたって。: ...Tsubaki said she saw it coming. Saw it, and still couldn't react in time.
messages.あたしは読まない。読む前に当てる。それしかないでしょ。: I'm not going to read her. I'll land my punch before I need to. What else is there?
messages.それでいい。ただ、当てに行く時に手が下がる。あいつは、そこを見逃さない。: That's fine. But your hand drops when you move in to hit. She won't miss that opening.
messages.……分かってる。次は、当てに行くときも手を下げない。そこ、見ててよ。: ...I know. This time, I'll keep my guard up when I move in. Watch for that, okay?
messages.（怒っている。でも、ただ突っ込むつもりじゃない。……それが分かるだけで、十分だ）: (She's angry. But she's not planning to charge in blindly. ...Knowing that is enough.)
messages.……あたし、椿に勝ったとき、嬉しかったのよ。ちゃんと。: ...I was happy when I beat Tsubaki. I really was.
messages.でも今は、あいつがリングにいないのが、こんなに嫌だなんて思わなかった。: But I never thought I'd hate seeing her out of the ring this much.
messages.だから、あいつが戻る前に片付けとく。で、あいつの前で言うの。『次はあんたよ』って: So I'll finish this before she's back. Then I'll tell her to her face: "You're next." ...Come on, let's go!
messages.第1認定戦突破くらい当然よ。……でも、あんたの指示は悪くなかった。: Of course I passed the first qualifier. ...But your instructions weren't bad.
messages.こっちこそ信じてくれてありがとうな: And thank you for trusting me.
messages.次は最終認定戦、氷室 椿だ。今までより手強いぞ。: Next is the final qualifier against Tsubaki Himuro. She'll be tougher than your last opponent.
messages.望むところ。あいつを倒して、あたしがジムを代表するって認めさせる！: Bring it on. I'll beat her and make them recognize me as this gym's representative!
messages.椿に勝って、ジムの代表になれた……。次は花冠王座戦。いよいよなのよね。: I beat Tsubaki. I'm representing the gym... Next is the Flower Crown title fight. It's really happening.
messages.まさか。あんたとここまで来たんだもの。王者だってぶっ飛ばして、ベルトを奪うわ！: As if. We came this far together. I'll knock the champion down and take that belt!
messages.紅 蓮華の一撃が相手をマットに沈めた。: Renge Kurenai's punch sent her opponent to the canvas.
messages.紅 蓮華は最後まで試合を支配し、勝利をつかんだ。: Renge Kurenai controlled the fight to the end and claimed victory.
messages.決着をつけられず、キャンペーンはここで終わった。: The fight ended without a winner, and the campaign ended here.
messages.紅 蓮華は競り負けた。鍛え直して再挑戦しよう。: Renge Kurenai lost a close fight. Train up and try again.
messages.サンドバッグ、ここまでね。……ねえ、あんた。: That's enough heavy bag work. ...Hey, you.
messages.走り終わったわ。息が落ち着いたら、少し話せる？: I've finished my run. Can we talk once I've caught my breath?
messages.スパーはここまで。……あんた、ちょっといい？: That's it for sparring. ...Got a minute?
messages.今日は休めたわ。……体のこと、ちゃんと見てるのね。: I got some rest today. ...You really are keeping an eye on me.
messages.第1認定戦突破！ ……ほら、あんたも喜びなさいよ。あたしたち、勝ったんだから。: First qualifier cleared! ...Come on, you can celebrate too. We won!
messages.ああ、見てた。おめでとう、蓮華。: Yeah, I saw it. Congratulations, Renge.
messages.……椿に勝った。あたしがジムの代表、か。……あんたと、ここまで来たのよね。: ...I beat Tsubaki. So I'm representing the gym. ...We made it this far together.
messages.ああ。ジムの推薦を勝ち取ったんだ。二人で喜ぼう。: Yeah. You earned the gym's backing. Let's enjoy this together.
messages.花冠王座のチャンピオンに、勝ったのよね。……ねえ、あんた。ちゃんと見てた？: I beat the Flower Crown champion, didn't I? ...Hey. You were watching, right?
messages.……勝った。これで椿に、顔を上げて会えるわ。……あんたも、一緒に来なさいよ。: ...I won. Now I can face Tsubaki with my head held high. ...You're coming with me, too.
messages.ああ。一緒に伝えよう、蓮華。: Yeah. Let's tell her together, Renge.
messages.今度は、あたしたちの勝ち！ ……あんた、最後まで付き合ってくれたわね。: This time, we win! ...You really stuck with me all the way.
messages.ああ。もう一度挑んで、つかんだ一勝だ。: Yeah. We came back and earned this one.
messages.相手の癖を読み切る技巧派ボクサー。: A technical boxer who reads her opponent's every habit.
messages.読み切って、こちらから動く: Read the opening. Make the first move.
messages.スパーリングで読みを磨きつつ、速さも一緒に乗せていく。: Sharpen your reads through sparring while building speed.
messages.……よろしく。あなたの指示には従う。合理的なら、だけど。: ...It's good to work with you. I'll follow your instructions. If they're rational.
messages.（クールだ。でも、勝利への熱は隠せていない）: (She's cool and composed. But she can't hide how much she wants to win.)
messages.なら、一つずつ確かめよう。試合は4週ごとに1つ。二つの認定戦に勝てば、ジムの推薦: Then let's take it one step at a time. One bout every four weeks. Win both qualifiers, and the gym will back your Flower Crown title challenge.
messages.第1認定戦の相手はジムの新人だ。まずはこの公式戦で、挑戦候補として実力を示そう。: Your first qualifier is against the gym's rookie. Prove you're a contender in this official bout.
messages.……データは十分。癖も、もう三つ見えている。まずはこの認定戦を通るわ。: ...I have enough data. I've already spotted three habits. First, I pass this qualifier.
messages.（同じジムの相手だ。向こうも椿を見ている。……読み合いは、もう始まっている）: (They're from the same gym. Her opponent has been watching Tsubaki, too. ...The battle of reads has already begun.)
messages.最終認定戦の相手、甘音の資料だ。ここに勝てばジム代表だが……まだデータが少ない。: Here's the file on Amane, your final qualifier. Win this and you represent the gym... though we still don't have much data.
messages.……読む前に、次が来る。……正直に言うと、少し、嫌な相手ね。: ...Before I can read one punch, the next arrives. ...Honestly, she's a troublesome opponent.
messages.（珍しく、椿の指先が紙の端を小さく折っていた）: (Unusually for her, Tsubaki folded a tiny corner of the paper between her fingers.)
messages.椿ちゃん、いた！ ……あ、おにいちゃんも。それ、最終認定戦の資料？: There you are, Tsubaki! ...Oh, Onii-chan's here too. Is that the file for the final qualifier?
messages.ジム代表の枠、わたしも譲らないよ。……全力で行くからね！: I'm not giving up that spot either. ...I'm going all out!
messages.……ええ。四週間、読ませてもらうわ。: ...Yes. I'll have four weeks to read you.
messages.読まれる前に、走っちゃうもん！ じゃあね！: I'll be off running before you can! See you!
messages.（宣戦布告というより、挨拶だ。……なのに椿は、折った紙の端を、指で伸ばし直してい: (It sounded more like a hello than a declaration of war. ...Yet Tsubaki kept smoothing that folded corner with her finger.)
messages.花冠王座を持つ現チャンピオンの資料だ。……戦績も映像も、ひと通り揃えた。: Here's the reigning Flower Crown champion's file. ...I've gathered her record and footage.
messages.……揃えても、勝率の計算が終わらない。変数が多すぎる。: ...Even with all that, I can't finish calculating my chances. Too many variables.
messages.……でも、あなたの目を足せば足りる。そう決めたでしょう。: ...But your eyes can make up the difference. We decided that, didn't we?
messages.四週間ある。待つだけの形は捨てて、こちらから動かす形を、王者用に組み直すぞ。: We have four weeks. No more just waiting. We'll adapt our approach to make the champion move first.
messages.……ええ。この資料の相手は、待っていても来ない。来させる側に回る。そこまでは、計: ...Yes. The woman in this file won't come to me if I wait. I'll make her. That part of the calculation is complete.
messages.終わっていないのは、私がどこまで踏み込めるか。……それは、四週間で埋める。: What remains is how far I can commit. ...I'll work that out in these four weeks.
messages.（資料を持つ椿の指は、今度は紙の端を折らなかった）: (This time, Tsubaki's fingers didn't fold the edge of the file.)
messages.……あなた。次にスパーを組むとき、相手をしてくれる？: ...Would you be my partner next time we spar?
messages.もちろん。……珍しいな、頼み事なんて: Of course. ...It's rare for you to ask a favor.
messages.合理的でしょう。私の癖を一番知っているのは、あなた。……それだけよ: It's rational, isn't it? You know my habits better than anyone. ...That's all.
messages.（『それだけ』の前に、少しだけ間があった）: (There was a small pause before "that's all.")
messages.……問題ない。心拍は管理の範囲内。続行が合理的よ。: ...I'm fine. My heart rate is under control. Continuing is the rational choice.
messages.……体調は管理の範囲内。休養の時間も、予定通りよ。: ...My condition is under control. This rest period is going as planned.
messages.顔に出てるぞ。十分だけ休もう。: It's written all over your face. Take ten minutes.
messages.なら、今日はそのまま休もう。試合のことばかり考えなくてもいい。: Then keep resting today. You don't have to spend every moment thinking about the fight.
messages.…………五分。あなたがそう言うなら、五分だけ。: ...Five minutes. If you insist, five minutes.
messages.…………あなたがそう言うなら。少しだけ、考えるのをやめるわ。: ...If you say so. I'll stop thinking about it for a little while.
messages.因幡 甘音。癖が少ない、というより……読む前に次が来る。データが足りないわ。: Amane Inaba. It's not so much a lack of habits... The next attack comes before I can read her. I need more data.
messages.なら体で覚えよう。今日から俺が甘音役だ。前進圧力を止めずにかける。グローブとプロ: Then learn by feel. I'll play Amane from today on, keeping the forward pressure on. Gloves, protective gear, and agreed limits.
messages.なら、まず動きを説明する。俺が甘音役だと考えてくれ。前進圧力を止めずにかけてくる: Then I'll explain her movements first. Imagine I'm playing Amane. How would you stop someone who keeps pressing forward?
messages.……その役、あなたが受ける被弾込みでしょう。非合理よ。: ...That role includes taking hits yourself. That's irrational.
messages.……実際にその役をするつもり？ あなたが受ける被弾込みなら、非合理よ。: ...Are you actually going to play that role? If it involves you getting hit, it's irrational.
messages.待って読むだけじゃ、あの連打は捌けない。やるぞ。: You can't handle that barrage by waiting and reading alone. Let's go.
messages.今日は説明だけだ。ただ、待って読むだけじゃ、あの連打は捌けない。: Today is explanation only. But waiting and reading alone won't stop that barrage.
messages.……その被弾は明日の練習効率に響く。回復も計算に入れて。……ねえ、聞いてる？ も: ...Those hits will affect tomorrow's training. Factor in recovery, too. ...Are you listening? You've taken enough already...!
messages.……なら、説明だけにして。あなたが打たれるところまで想像したくない。……ねえ、聞: ...Then keep it to an explanation. I don't even want to imagine you getting hit. ...Are you listening?
messages.（戦術の話が、少しずつ、俺の身体の話になっていく）: (The discussion of tactics slowly becomes a discussion of my body.)
messages.（前へ。まだ前へ。椿が自分から動くまで——いや、その必要はなかった）: (Forward. Keep moving forward until Tsubaki makes her own move—no, I didn't need to wait.)
messages.（体を休めたまま、前へ出てくる相手の動きを説明する。俺が「甘音役なら」と口にした: (While we rest, I explain how a pressing opponent moves. It happened just as I said, "If I were playing Amane...")
messages.（読んで返すはずの椿が、自分から踏み込んで、俺を止めた。クリンチだ。……いや、こ: (Tsubaki, who should have read and countered, stepped in herself and stopped me. A clinch. ...No, this is...)
messages.（椿が不意に身を寄せ、俺を抱き留めた。クリンチのような近さだ。……いや、これは）: (Tsubaki suddenly leaned in and held me. Close as a clinch. ...No, this is...)
messages.（あの日、椿と閉じ込められたエレベーター。開かない扉を、俺は内側から拳で叩いた）: (That day in the elevator, trapped with Tsubaki. I punched the doors from inside, trying to force them open.)
messages.（そのとき傷めた拳で、俺は選手としての道を終えた。……椿は今も、あの日のことを抱: (The damage to my fists ended my boxing career. ...Tsubaki still carries that day with her.)
messages.なんで……なんで、あんなことしたの……！ 待っていれば、助かったかもしれないじゃ: Why... Why did you do that...?! If we'd waited, someone might have saved us...!
messages.拳を壊してまで、私なんかを助ける必要なんて……なかったのに……！: You didn't have to ruin your fists... just to save someone like me...!
messages.必要だったんだよ。あの時も、待っていたら間に合わなかった。: I did. Back then, waiting would have been too late.
messages.（しばらく、そのままでいた。……背中に、そっと片手を添える）: (We stayed like that for a while. ...I gently placed a hand on her back.)
messages.……それに、ほら。こうしてクリンチの練習もできた。: ...Besides, look. We even got some clinch practice out of it.
messages.……相手を止めるには、自分から近づく手もある。クリンチの話は……今は、それだけに: ...Sometimes you stop an opponent by closing the distance yourself. That's all we need to say about clinching... for now.
messages.…………最低の、コーチね。……今のは、合理的じゃなかったわ。私も、あなたも。: ...You're the worst coach. ...That wasn't rational. Neither of us was.
messages.今度の甘音戦。方針を変える。待つカウンターだけじゃ足りない。: I'm changing our approach for the Amane fight. Waiting to counter won't be enough.
messages.こちらから動かす。フェイントで、あの子の感情ごと引き出して——そこを打つ。: Make her move. Use a feint to draw out her emotions, too—and strike there.
messages.根拠は不完全よ。データも足りない。……でも、あなたの読みも、私の判断材料に入れる: The evidence is incomplete. The data, too. ...But I've decided to factor your judgment into mine.
messages.……勝率は十分。行くわよ。: ...Our chances are good enough. Let's go.
messages.次にスパーを組むなら、相手は蓮華に頼むわ。あなたは、外から見て。: Next time I spar, I'll ask Renge to be my partner. You watch from outside.
messages.俺が受けたほうが早いぞ。慣れてる。: It's faster if I do it. I'm used to it.
messages.……効率の話じゃないの。あなたの被弾は、もう計算に入れない。……入れたくないのよ: ...This isn't about efficiency. I'm no longer factoring you getting hit into my plans. ...I don't want to.
messages.（合理的、と言わなかった。……それが、答えだった）: (She didn't call it rational. ...That was my answer.)
messages.……昨夜、心拍が管理の範囲を出た。三十分。: ...Last night, my heart rate went outside its normal range. For thirty minutes.
messages.王者戦が近いからな。誰でもそうなる。: The title fight is getting close. It happens to everyone.
messages.原因は王者じゃない。……声が、耳に残っていただけ。あなたの。: The champion wasn't the cause. ...A voice was still in my ears. Yours.
messages.勝率は下がった、と言ったわね。……上げ方は、もう決めてある。: You said our chances had dropped. ...I've already decided how to raise them.
messages.乱入者を、私が引き出す。感情ごと。……甘音戦と同じ。ただし今度は、私の感情も乗せ: I'll draw our intruder out. Emotions and all. ...Like with Amane. Only this time, my emotions are part of it too.
messages.……ええ。でも、合理的な私は、あの子を止められなかった。: ...Yes. But the rational version of me couldn't stop her.
messages.……ねえ。あの時。あなたは、怖くなかったの。: ...Tell me. Back then. Weren't you afraid?
messages.怖かったさ。……でも、待ってるほうが、もっと怖かった。: I was. ...But waiting scared me even more.
messages.……そう。……なら、私も同じ答えを出すだけね。『怖い』は判断材料にならない。前に: ...I see. ...Then I only need to reach the same conclusion. "Fear isn't a factor." I said that before.
messages.（判断材料にならない、と言いながら、声は少しだけ小さかった）: (She said it wasn't a factor, but her voice was a little quieter.)
messages.氷室 椿は完璧な組み立てで王者を沈めた。「……計算通り。あなたとの、ね」: Tsubaki Himuro dismantled the champion with flawless tactics. "...Just as calculated. By the two of us."
messages.冷静に試合を支配し、判定勝ち。「勝因はあなたの指示。……半分は、だけど」: She calmly controlled the bout and won on points. "Your instructions won this. ...Half of it, at least."
messages.読み切れず、キャンペーンはここで終わった。「……敗因は明確。次は、こうはならない: Unable to read her opponent, she ended her campaign here. "...The cause is clear. Next time will be different."
messages.仕上がりが足りず、競り負けた。「……私の判断ミス。あなたのせいじゃないわ」: She fell short in a close fight. "...My error in judgment. It wasn't your fault."
messages.第1認定戦、通過。……あなたの指示は概ね合理的だった。概ね、ね。: First qualifier passed. ...Your instructions were mostly rational. Mostly.
messages.（『概ね』。椿の採点なら、それは合格点だ。……認められた、と思っていい）: ("Mostly." By Tsubaki's standards, that's a passing grade. ...I can take that as approval.)
messages.次は最終認定戦、因幡 甘音。ここに勝てば、ジムの代表として花冠王座へ挑める。: Next is the final qualifier against Amane Inaba. Win, and you'll represent the gym in the Flower Crown title fight.
messages.データの少ない、読みにくい相手。……いいわ。読めないなら、読めるまで観察するだけ: An unpredictable opponent, with little data. ...Fine. If I can't read her, I'll keep watching until I can.
messages.……勝った。最後まで読み切れた訳ではなかったけれど。: ...I won. Though I never managed to read her completely.
messages.これでジムの推薦を得られた。次は花冠王座戦だ。怖いか？: You've earned the gym's backing. Next is the Flower Crown title fight. Scared?
messages.「怖い」は判断材料にならない。……ただ、私の読みとあなたの目。二つ揃えば、勝率は: Fear isn't a factor. ...My reads and your eyes. Together, they give us a good enough chance.
messages.サンドバッグは終了。……少し、話をしてもいいかしら。: Heavy bag work is finished. ...May we talk for a moment?
messages.ロードワークは終了。息を整えながら、話しましょう。: Roadwork is finished. Let's talk while we catch our breath.
messages.スパーは終了。……確認しておきたいことがあるの。: Sparring is finished. ...There's something I'd like to check.
messages.今日は体を休めたわ。……話をする時間は、あるでしょう。: I've rested today. ...We have time to talk, don't we?
messages.第1認定戦、勝利。……思っていたより、嬉しいものね。あなたに伝えるのは。: First qualifier won. ...Telling you feels nicer than I expected.
messages.……甘音に勝った。あなたと出した答えで、ここまで来られたのね。: ...I beat Amane. The answer we found together brought us this far.
messages.おめでとう、椿。ジム代表の座、二人で喜ぼう。: Congratulations, Tsubaki. Let's celebrate earning that spot together.
messages.……花冠王座、取れたのね。少し、待って。あなたの顔を見たら、実感が湧いてきた。: ...I've won the Flower Crown title. Give me a moment. Seeing your face is making it feel real.
messages.……勝ったわ。甘音にも、伝えなくちゃ。あなたと一緒に、ここまで来たこと。: ...I won. I need to tell Amane. That we came all this way together.
messages.ああ。まずは、おめでとう。ちゃんと伝えさせてくれ。: Yeah. But first, congratulations. Let me say that properly.
messages.今度は勝利。……再挑戦を選んでよかった。あなたと、もう一度向き合えて。: Victory this time. ...I'm glad we tried again. That I could face it with you once more.
messages.おめでとう、椿。今度は二人で、勝った結果を受け止めよう。: Congratulations, Tsubaki. This time, let's take in our victory together.
messages.止まらない連打で押し切る前進型ボクサー。: A pressure fighter who overwhelms opponents with nonstop combinations.
messages.第2戦で戦い方を教わり、ロードワークでスタミナと速さを揃える。: Learn your fighting style during the second bout's training, then build stamina and speed with roadwork.
messages.第2戦の「勝ちたい」と伝える練習イベント後: After the second bout's training event where you say you want to win
messages.わー！ おにいちゃんがトレーナーになってくれるの!? やったー！ いっぱい練習し: Wow! You're going to be my trainer, Onii-chan?! Yay! Let's train lots!
messages.（この元気と速さなら、もっと上まで駆け上がれる）: (With this energy and speed, she can climb so much higher.)
messages.最初の試合まで4週間だ。二つの認定戦に勝って、ジムのみんなに送り出してもらおう。: Four weeks until your first fight. Let's win both qualifiers and have everyone at the gym send you off. We're aiming for the Flower Crown title.
messages.第1認定戦の相手はジムの新人だ。練習じゃなく、挑戦候補として実力を示す公式戦にな: Your first qualifier is against the gym's rookie. This isn't practice—it's an official bout to prove you're a contender.
messages.あ、ジムでよく見る人だ！ ……近くで見ると、おっきいね。: Oh, I see that person at the gym all the time! ...They look big up close.
messages.……でも、足はわたしのほうが速いよね？ ね、おにいちゃん？: ...But I'm faster on my feet, right? Right, Onii-chan?
messages.最終認定戦の相手、蓮華の資料だ。ここを越えれば、ジムの代表として花冠王座に挑める: Here's Renge's file for the final qualifier. Get past her, and you'll represent the gym in a Flower Crown title challenge.
messages.うん……。写真でも、なんか、こわい顔してる。……蓮華ちゃんに勝たなきゃ、代表には: Yeah... She looks kind of scary even in the photo. ...I have to beat Renge to represent the gym, don't I?
messages.（紙を持つ手が、わずかに下がった。……それでも、目は蓮華の顔から離れない）: (The paper dips slightly in her hands. ...But her eyes stay fixed on Renge's face.)
messages.花冠王座を持つ現チャンピオンの資料だ。みんなに認められて、今度はジムの代表として: Here's the reigning Flower Crown champion's file. Everyone has recognized you. Now you challenge her as the gym's representative.
messages.……わたしが、ジムの代表なんだね。王者さんの写真を見たら、急にドキドキしてきた。: ...So I'm representing the gym. Seeing the champion's photo suddenly made my heart race.
messages.王者は、真っ先に甘音の足を止めに来る。四週間で、その先まで走れる脚を作るぞ。: The champion will try to stop your feet first. We'll use these four weeks to build legs that can keep going beyond that.
messages.うん。……ね、おにいちゃん。蓮華ちゃんのときの連打、王者さんにも届くかな。: Yeah. ...Hey, Onii-chan. Will the combination I used against Renge work on the champion, too?
messages.今のままなら、たぶん届かない。……だから四週間ある。: As you are now, probably not. ...That's why we have four weeks.
messages.……そっか。うん、そうだよね。じゃあ、いっぱい走る！ その写真、もう一回だけ見せ: ...Oh. Yeah, you're right. Then I'll run lots! Let me see that photo one more time.
messages.（紙を覗き込む顔は、もう写真にドキドキしている顔じゃなかった。走る前の顔だ）: (The face peering at the photo isn't nervous anymore. It's the face she makes before a run.)
messages.おにいちゃん、あのね。……今日、ちょっとだけしんどかった。: Onii-chan, um... Today was a little tough.
messages.おにいちゃん、あのね。……休んだけど、まだちょっとだるいかも。: Onii-chan, um... I rested, but I still feel a little sluggish.
messages.おにいちゃん、あのね。……今日、走るの、ちょっとだけしんどかった。: Onii-chan, um... Running was a little tough today.
messages.言ってくれて助かる。今日はもう終わりにしよう。次のメニューも、体調を見て決める。: Thanks for telling me. That's enough for today. I'll check how you feel before picking the next session, too.
messages.言ってくれて助かる。今日はこのまま休もう。次のメニューも、体調を見て決める。: Thanks for telling me. Keep resting today. I'll check how you feel before picking the next session, too.
messages.怒らないさ。ちゃんと言えたのが偉い: Of course not. I'm glad you told me.
messages.えへへ。じゃあ、次もちゃんと体のこと、言うね！: Hehe. Then I'll tell you how I'm feeling next time, too!
messages.……ふぅ。ねえ、おにいちゃん。わたし、ちゃんとできてる？: ...Whew. Hey, Onii-chan. Am I doing okay?
messages.ねえ、おにいちゃん。休むのも、ちゃんと準備になってる？: Hey, Onii-chan. Resting counts as getting ready too, right?
messages.ああ。自分の調子をちゃんと確かめられてる。: Yeah. You're paying attention to how you feel.
messages.ああ。体を休めるのも、試合へ向けた準備だ。: Yeah. Resting your body is part of preparing for a fight.
messages.えへへ、そっかー！ じゃあ、次もちゃんと見ててね！: Hehe, really? Then watch me next time, too!
messages.（蓮華に頼んだ練習スパー。甘音は一発ごとに力んで、そのたびに読まれて、はっきり負: (I'd asked Renge to help with a practice spar. Amane tensed up on every punch, was read every time, and lost decisively.)
messages.（サンドバッグを終えた甘音に、蓮華が声をかけた。一発ずつ力を込める打ち方が、気に: (Renge spoke to Amane after her heavy bag session. The way Amane loaded up on each individual punch seemed to bother her.)
messages.（体を休めながら、甘音と蓮華が次の試合について話している。甘音は、一発の重さで勝: (Resting together, Amane and Renge talk about the coming bout. Amane insists she wants to win with heavy single punches.)
messages.……えへへ。まだまだだね、わたし。: ...Hehe. I've still got a long way to go.
messages.……やっぱり、重い一発がないと、だめなのかな。: ...Maybe I really do need one big punch.
messages.……ねえ。それ、あんたのボクシングじゃないでしょ。見てれば分かる。あんた、そんな: ...Hey. That isn't your boxing, is it? Anyone watching can tell. You're not the kind of fighter who punches like that.
messages.……ねえ。それ、あんたのボクシングじゃないでしょ。あんた、そんなふうに打つ選手じ: ...Hey. That isn't your boxing, is it? You're not the kind of fighter who punches like that.
messages.——自分だって……おにいちゃんみたいに戦えないくせに！: —You can't... You can't fight like Onii-chan either!
messages.……ちがう。いまの、ちがうの。……ごめんなさい……！: ...No. That wasn't... I didn't mean that. ...I'm sorry...!
messages.（甘音は返事を待たずに、駆け出していった）: (Amane runs off without waiting for an answer.)
messages.（甘音を追いかけて、ジムを飛び出す。向かった先は、河川敷だった）: (I chase Amane out of the gym. She heads toward the riverbank.)
messages.（河川敷の階段で、甘音は膝を抱えて座っていた。少し離れた隣に、黙って座る）: (Amane sits on the riverside steps, hugging her knees. I sit quietly beside her, leaving a little space.)
messages.蓮華ちゃん、すごい顔してた。わたし、ひどいこと言った。……謝ったけど、あんなの、: You should've seen Renge's face. What I said was awful. ...I said sorry, but that hardly counts as an apology, does it?
messages.リングの外で人を傷つけたなら、あとでちゃんと謝ればいい。それとは別に——リングに: If you hurt someone outside the ring, apologize properly afterward. But inside the ring, what remains is whether you won or lost. As you are now, Amane, you'll lose.
messages.甘音は、どうしたい？: What do you want to do, Amane?
messages.よし、じゃあジムに戻って練習だ。甘音の戦い方を教えてやる。: Good. Then let's go back to the gym and train. I'll teach you your way of fighting.
messages.よし。今日は体を休めたまま、甘音の戦い方を考えよう。相手をコーナーへ追い込むとこ: Good. Today, let's work out your way of fighting while you rest. Start by imagining you have your opponent backed into a corner.
messages.うん。ここで聞く。教えて、おにいちゃん。: Yeah. I'll listen here. Teach me, Onii-chan.
messages.はぁ・・はぁ・・・。褒めてもらえて、うれしかったのに、消えなかったの。悔しいの。: Hah... hah... Your praise made me happy, but the feeling didn't go away. Losing hurts. ...I want to win.
messages.褒めてもらえて、うれしかったのに、消えなかったの。悔しいの。……わたし、勝ちたい: Your praise made me happy, but the feeling didn't go away. Losing hurts. ...I want to win.
messages.ちゃんと言えたな。じゃあ次は戦い方を仕上げていくぞ。: You said it clearly. Now let's put the finishing touches on your fighting style.
messages.ちゃんと言えたな。相手をコーナーへ追い込んだら、一発で終わらせようとせず、次のパ: You said it clearly. Once you've backed them into the corner, don't try to finish it with one punch. Link it to the next. Picture the sequence.
messages.一発で止めないで、次、その次……。わたしの連打で、逃がさないんだね。: Don't stop at one. The next, then the next... Don't let them escape my barrage.
messages.そうだ！その調子だ！連打を叩き込め！: That's it! Keep it up! Let those punches fly!
messages.そうだ。そのつなぎ方を覚えておこう。実際に打つのは、体を休めてからだ。: That's right. Remember how to link them. We'll throw the actual punches once you've rested.
messages.蓮華ちゃん。……この前は、ごめんなさい。悔しくて、おにいちゃんまで否定されたみた: Renge... I'm sorry about the other day. I was frustrated, and it felt like you'd rejected Onii-chan, too. But that didn't give me the right to say something like that.
messages.……いいわ。あたしも、言い方がキツかったし。: ...It's fine. I was too harsh, too.
messages.けど——リングの上では、最後に残るのは勝ったか負けたかだけよ。手加減はしてあげな: But in the ring, all that remains is whether you won or lost. I'm not going easy on you.
messages.……ふふっ。おにいちゃんと同じこと言うんだもん。……ちょっとだけ、ずるい。: ...Hehe. That's just what Onii-chan said. ...It's a little unfair.
messages.おにいちゃん、次に走るときは一緒に来て！ 王者さん用の、ながーいやつ！: Onii-chan, come with me on my next run! A really long one, for the champion!
messages.おにいちゃん、今日も走り終わったよ！ 次は一緒に来て。王者さん用の、ながーいやつ: Onii-chan, I've finished my run! Come with me next time. A really long one, for the champion!
messages.コーチは自転車で並走だ。: The coach rides alongside on a bike.
messages.えー、ずるい！ ……でも、いいや。隣にいてくれるなら、それで。: Aww, that's cheating! ...But okay. As long as you're beside me.
messages.（隣にいてくれるなら、と甘音は笑う。……試合の日も、その顔を見ていたい）: (Amane smiles as she says, "As long as you're beside me." ...I want to see that smile on fight day, too.)
messages.ね、おにいちゃん。王者さんに勝ったら、わたし、チャンピオンになるんだよね。: Hey, Onii-chan. If I beat the champion, that makes me the champion, right?
messages.……そしたら、おにいちゃんは、チャンピオンのコーチだ。えへへ、なんか、すごいね。: ...Then you'll be a champion's coach. Hehe. That sounds kind of amazing.
messages.……ちゃんと、なるからね。おにいちゃんのこと、すごいコーチにしてあげる。: ...I'll make it happen. I'll make you an amazing coach.
messages.（順番が逆だ、と言いかけて、やめた。……この子は本気で、そう思っている）: (I almost told her she had it backward, then stopped. ...She really believes that.)
messages.（今日の甘音は、いつもの半分も走れなかった。足が、途中で何度も止まった）: (Today, Amane couldn't manage even half her usual run. Her feet stopped again and again.)
messages.（今日の甘音は、サンドバッグを打つ手が途中で何度も止まった）: (Today, Amane's hands kept stopping during heavy bag work.)
messages.（今日の甘音は、スパーの途中で何度も動きを止めた）: (Today, Amane kept freezing in the middle of sparring.)
messages.（体を休めていても、甘音の表情は晴れなかった。何かを思い出したように、言葉が途切: (Even while resting, Amane's expression doesn't clear. Her words trail off, as if she's remembering something.)
messages.……ごめん、おにいちゃん。あの人の顔、思い出しちゃって。蓮華ちゃんが倒れたとこも: ...Sorry, Onii-chan. I keep remembering her face. And Renge falling.
messages.止まっていい。……止まった回数、数えてたか？: It's okay to stop. ...Did you count how many times you stopped?
messages.今日は休んでいていい。怖いと思ったことも、ここで話していいんだ。: You can rest today. And you can tell me what scares you.
messages.……休んでても、考えちゃうの。次、ちゃんと動けるかなって。: ...Even resting, I keep thinking about it. Whether I'll be able to move next time.
messages.じゃあ、次は三回を目指そう。それでいい。: Then let's aim for three next time. That's enough.
messages.次は、一度に全部できなくてもいい。一つずつ確かめよう。: You don't have to do everything at once next time. We'll take it one step at a time.
messages.……うん。一つずつ。おにいちゃん、そばにいてね。: ...Yeah. One step at a time. Stay with me, Onii-chan.
messages.蓮華ちゃん、言ってた。『あたしの分まで、当ててきなさい』って。……でもね、おにい: Renge told me, "Land some for me, too." ...But Onii-chan, I don't think I can throw her punches for her.
messages.だって、蓮華ちゃんのパンチ、わたしには打てないもん。だから、わたしの分を、いっぱ: Because I can't punch like Renge. So I'll land lots of my own. Every one of them, my own barrage.
messages.（誰の真似でもない、と前に言った。……今度は、俺が言うまでもなかった）: (I told her before that she wasn't copying anyone. ...This time, I didn't have to say it.)
messages.因幡 甘音のラッシュは、最後まで止まらなかった。「おにいちゃん、わたし、勝ったよ: Amane Inaba's barrage never stopped. "Onii-chan, I won!"
messages.足を止めない連打で判定勝ち。「見てた？ ぜんぶ見ててくれたよね！」: She kept her feet and fists moving to win on points. "Did you see? You watched the whole thing, right?!"
messages.あと一歩、追い切れなかった。「……ここで終わり、かぁ」: She fell just short of catching her opponent. "...So this is where it ends."
messages.押し切れずに敗北。「……悔しい。……ね、おにいちゃん。わたし、ちゃんと悔しいって: Unable to break through, she lost. "...It hurts. ...Hey, Onii-chan. I really do hate losing now."
messages.第1認定戦、勝ったー！ おにいちゃん、見てた!? ほめてほめて！: I won the first qualifier! Onii-chan, did you see?! Tell me I did great!
messages.（真っ先に俺を探した。……任せてもらえている、ということだ）: (She looked for me first. ...She's put her trust in me.)
messages.見てたよ。よく勝ち切ったな。次は最終認定戦、紅 蓮華だ。: I saw it. You earned that win. Next is the final qualifier against Renge Kurenai.
messages.蓮華ちゃんかぁ……。代表の枠をかけて戦うんだよね。……でも、わたしだって負けない: Renge, huh... We'll be fighting for the gym's spot, right? ...But I'm not losing either!
messages.……勝てて、ジム代表になれた。ね、おにいちゃん。いまの、わたしのボクシングだった: ...I won. I'm representing the gym. Hey, Onii-chan. That was my boxing, wasn't it?
messages.ああ。甘音が自分でつかんだ、ジムの推薦だ。: Yeah. You earned the gym's backing yourself, Amane.
messages.えへへ。……次は花冠王座の王者さんだね。みんなに、勝ったよって言えるように頑張る: Hehe. ...Next is the Flower Crown champion. I'll do my best so I can tell everyone I won!
messages.サンドバッグ、おしまい！ ね、おにいちゃん、少しお話しよ。: Heavy bag work, done! Hey, Onii-chan, let's talk a little.
messages.走り終わったよ、おにいちゃん。息が落ち着くまで、お話ししていい？: I've finished my run, Onii-chan. Can we talk while I catch my breath?
messages.スパー、おしまい。ね、おにいちゃん、聞いてほしいことがあるの。: Sparring's done. Hey, Onii-chan, there's something I want you to hear.
messages.今日はゆっくり休めたよ。ね、おにいちゃん、ちょっとお話しよ。: I got plenty of rest today. Hey, Onii-chan, let's talk a little.
messages.第1認定戦、勝ったぁ！ おにいちゃん、わたし、認定戦で勝てたよ！ ね、一緒に喜ん: I won the first qualifier! Onii-chan, I really won! Come on, celebrate with me!
messages.蓮華ちゃんに勝って、代表になれた……！ おにいちゃん、わたし、ちゃんと嬉しい！: I beat Renge and earned the gym's spot...! Onii-chan, I'm so happy!
messages.ああ。甘音がつかんだ一勝だ。おめでとう。: Yeah. You earned this win, Amane. Congratulations.
messages.おにいちゃん！ わたし、花冠王座のチャンピオンになったよ！ おにいちゃんも、チャ: Onii-chan! I'm the Flower Crown champion! And you're a champion's coach now!
messages.ああ。おめでとう、甘音。一緒にここまで来られたな。: Yeah. Congratulations, Amane. We made it here together.
messages.勝ったよ……！ おにいちゃん、蓮華ちゃんに教えてあげよ。わたしたち、勝ったよって: I won...! Onii-chan, let's tell Renge. Tell her we won!
messages.ああ。一緒に伝えよう。おめでとう、甘音。: Yeah. Let's tell her together. Congratulations, Amane.
messages.今度は勝ったよ、おにいちゃん！ もう一回って決めて、よかった……！: I won this time, Onii-chan! I'm so glad we decided to try again...!
messages.おめでとう、甘音。二人でつかみ直した一勝だな。: Congratulations, Amane. We came back and earned this one together.
messages.最終確認だ。今日からコーチ、ということでいいんだな。: One last check. You're starting as a coach today, right?
messages.地域のジムが参加する興行で、うちに「花冠王座」への挑戦枠が一つ回ってきた。: Our gym has been offered one slot to challenge for the Flower Crown title, in a promotion featuring local gyms.
messages.送り出す選手には、同じジムの二人との認定戦に勝ってもらう。第1認定戦で実力を示し: Before I send someone, they'll have to beat two of our own in qualifying bouts. The first proves their ability; the final qualifier decides our representative.
messages.仲間との二戦を通れば、ジムの推薦で王者に挑める、ということですね。: So if they beat both gymmates, they can challenge the champion with the gym's backing.
messages.そうだ。認定戦も、この興行の公式記録に残る。練習のスパーとは別だ。: Exactly. The qualifiers count toward this promotion's official record. They're separate from practice sparring.
messages.勝ち取った認定は、この挑戦中は保持される。負けたり引き分けたりしても、枠が残って: Any qualification you earn stays with you during this campaign. After a loss or draw, you can retry that bout later if you have a fight slot left.
messages.試合は四週間ごと、再挑戦も含めて最大四試合だ。まずは、お前がコーチを務める選手を: One bout every four weeks, and no more than four bouts, retries included. First, choose which of these three you'll coach.
messages.新規開始から育成の手順を案内します。: Guides your training steps from the start of a new game.
messages.今週はこれがおすすめ！: Here's my pick for this week!
messages.この順番ならギャル戦まで大丈夫だよ。: Follow this order and you'll be ready for the gyaru fight, too.
messages.雪兎ちゃんの保証ルートから外れます。この練習で進めると、以後の勝利は保証対象外で: This leaves Yukito's guaranteed route. If you choose this training, future wins are no longer guaranteed.
messages.保証ルートから外れています。ここからの勝利は保証対象外です。: You've left the guaranteed route. Wins from this point are no longer guaranteed.
messages.この保存には手順の記録がないため、保証対象外です。保証ルートは新しく始めたプレイ: This save has no action history to verify, so the guarantee doesn't apply. Start a new game to follow the guaranteed route.
messages.青線と違う育て方でも大丈夫。最初からこの手順どおりに進めて、わたしを信じてくださ: It's okay if my plan differs from the blue markers. Follow these steps from the start and trust me! ♪
messages.どうもこんにちは、雪兎と申します。可愛く雪兎ちゃんと呼んでくれたらうれしいです。: Hello there! My name is Yukito. I'd love it if you called me Yukito-chan.
messages.とはいえ、試合は残念でしたね。あの人に勝つためのアドバイスをしにやってきました。: That match was a shame, though. I've come to offer some advice on how to beat her.
messages.初挑戦での勝利、おめでとうございます！ あなたには必要ないかもしれませんが、次の: Congratulations on winning your very first attempt! You may not need me, but I'd love to help on your next run, too.
messages.次に新しく始めるとき、選手選択で「雪兎ちゃん攻略モード」を選んで呼んでください。: Next time you start a new game, choose "Yukito's Guide Mode" when picking your boxer. Follow every step from the start and accept the post-title challenge, and I'll show you a route to beating the gyaru! ♪
messages.あ、今まで目標にしていた青線とは違う育て方になることもあります。青線は今の能力か: My training plan may differ from the blue markers. Those are targets based on your current stats; my plan starts at the beginning. Sorry if that looks confusing—but trust me! ♪
messages.3人のヒロインからひとりを選んで育成し、2度の公式認定戦を勝ち抜いて花冠王座へ挑: Choose one of three heroines, train her through two official qualifiers, and challenge for the Flower Crown title.
messages.試合まで4週間。得意練習と休養を組み合わせよう。: Four weeks until the fight. Balance your specialty training with rest.
messages.次のターンは強制休憩。休むのみ選択できます。: You must rest next turn. No other action is available.
messages.コンディションが限界だ。次のターンは休養しよう。: Your condition is at its limit. Rest next turn.
messages.キャンペーンの戦績が記録された。: Your campaign results have been recorded.
messages.新人・ライバル・現チャンピオンの3人すべてにKO勝ちしたヒロインへ、ギャル挑戦者: After knocking out the rookie, rival, and reigning champion, our heroine receives a challenge from the gyaru contender.
messages.限られた試合数の中で残した戦績を振り返る、紅 蓮華のシーズン記録。: Renge Kurenai looks back on the record she built within the season's limited bouts.
messages.……悔しい。ここで終わりにしたくない。あんた、次もあたしの隣にいなさいよ。: ...This hurts. I don't want it to end here. You're staying beside me next time, too.
messages.花冠王座の現チャンピオンを破り、新王者となった紅 蓮華の記録。: Renge Kurenai defeats the reigning Flower Crown champion and claims the title.
messages.見た？ あたしたちで、ここまで来たのよ。……ありがと。今日は素直に言っとく。: Did you see? We made it this far together. ...Thanks. Today, I'll say it straight.
messages.現王者を越え、ギャル挑戦者との決戦にも勝利した。: Having beaten the reigning champion, she also wins the showdown with the gyaru challenger.
messages.昔のストレートも、あんたと作った新しい拳も、全部届いた。……これからも隣で見てな: The old straight, the new punch we built together—every one of them reached her. ...Keep watching from my side.
messages.はぁ……はぁ……。……ねえ。あんた、まだそこにいる？: Hah... hah... ...Hey. Are you still there?
messages.（突き出された拳は、目の前で止まったままだ。……こっちの番、ということらしい）: (Her outstretched fist stops in front of me. ...Apparently, it's my turn.)
messages.……何してんのよ、早く。……それが済んだら、椿のとこ。報告、一緒に行くんだから。: ...What are you waiting for? Hurry up. ...Then we're going to see Tsubaki. We're telling her together.
messages.ギャル挑戦者には届かなかった。それでも、その挑戦はリングに確かな足跡を残した。: She couldn't beat the gyaru challenger. Still, her challenge left its mark on the ring.
messages.……届かなかった。でも、あたしたちの拳が間違ってたなんて思わない。次はもっと強く: ...It wasn't enough. But I don't think our punches were wrong. I'll be stronger next time. And you're coming with me.
messages.限られた試合数の中で残した戦績を振り返る、氷室 椿のシーズン記録。: Tsubaki Himuro looks back on the record she built within the season's limited bouts.
messages.……悔しい。敗因を整理して、また練習しましょう。あなたとなら、次を考えられる。: ...This hurts. Let's analyze why I lost, then train again. With you, I can think about what comes next.
messages.花冠王座の現チャンピオンを破り、新王者となった氷室 椿の記録。: Tsubaki Himuro defeats the reigning Flower Crown champion and claims the title.
messages.勝因は、私の判断とあなたの指示。……二人でつかんだ王座ね。ありがとう。: My judgment and your instructions. ...We won this title together. Thank you.
messages.待つだけじゃ届かなかった。踏み込むと決められたのは、あなたがいたから。……これか: Waiting alone wasn't enough. I could choose to step in because you were there. ...Stay with me from here on, too.
messages.……はぁ。……ごめんなさい。少しの間、立てそうにないわ。: ...Hah. ...I'm sorry. I don't think I can stand for a little while.
messages.座ってろ。今日は誰も、それを非合理とは言わない。: Stay seated. Nobody's calling that irrational today.
messages.グローブ越しだと、測れないものがあるって……もう、知っているから。: I already know... there are things you can't measure through a glove.
messages.（差し出された素手は、震えていない。……ただ、待っている）: (The bare hand she offers isn't shaking. ...It's simply waiting.)
messages.……立てたら、甘音のところへ。あの子、見てる、って言ったから。……報告は、私から: ...Once I can stand, let's go to Amane. She said she'd be watching. ...I'll tell her myself.
messages.……負けた。けれど、自分から踏み込んだことは後悔していない。あなたと、次の答えを: ...I lost. But I don't regret stepping in on my own. I want to find our next answer together.
messages.限られた試合数の中で残した戦績を振り返る、因幡 甘音のシーズン記録。: Amane Inaba looks back on the record she built within the season's limited bouts.
messages.……悔しい。ね、おにいちゃん。わたし、もっと強くなりたい。また一緒に練習してくれ: ...This hurts. Hey, Onii-chan. I want to get stronger. Will you train with me again?
messages.花冠王座の現チャンピオンを破り、新王者となった因幡 甘音の記録。: Amane Inaba defeats the reigning Flower Crown champion and claims the title.
messages.おにいちゃん、わたし、勝ったよ！ わたしのボクシングで！ ……うれしい。いっしょ: Onii-chan, I won! With my own boxing! ...I'm so happy. I want you to celebrate with me.
messages.わたしのラッシュ、最後まで届いたよ！ おにいちゃんが見ててくれて、うれしかった。: My barrage reached her all the way to the end! I was so happy you were watching, Onii-chan. ...Thank you!
messages.（こっちへ駆けてくる。両腕を広げて、笑って、泣いて……速すぎて、止まれるのか心配: (She runs toward me, arms wide, laughing and crying... so fast I worry she won't be able to stop.)
messages.怖かった！ ずっと、怖かった！ ……でも、行ってよかった。わたしのボクシングで、: I was scared! Scared the whole time! ...But I'm glad I went. I did it with my own boxing.
messages.ああ。……蓮華に、見せに行こう。あいつ、当ててこいって言ってた。: Yeah. ...Let's show Renge. She told you to land those punches.
messages.うん！ ……あ、でも、その前に。おにいちゃん、ちょっとだけ、動かないで。: Yeah! ...Oh, but first. Onii-chan, hold still for just a second.
messages.……負けちゃった。勝ちたかったなぁ。でも、わたしのボクシングで最後まで向かってい: ...I lost. I really wanted to win. But I kept going with my own boxing until the end. Thank you for watching.
messages.紅 蓮華が現王者を破った記録。: Renge Kurenai's victory over the reigning champion.
messages.氷室 椿が現王者を破った記録。: Tsubaki Himuro's victory over the reigning champion.
messages.因幡 甘音が現王者を破った記録。: Amane Inaba's victory over the reigning champion.
messages.ギャル挑戦者を撃破した記録。: A record of victory over the gyaru challenger.
messages.隠し戦で撃破に届かなかった記録。: A record of the unsuccessful challenge in the secret bout.
messages.紅 蓮華 — あの日のロッカールーム: Renge Kurenai — That Day in the Locker Room
messages.育成中の会話で見た一場面。: A scene witnessed during a training conversation.
messages.紅 蓮華 — ほどけた表情: Renge Kurenai — Letting Her Guard Down
messages.氷室 椿 — 引き止める手: Tsubaki Himuro — A Hand to Stop You
messages.氷室 椿 — 抱き留めた理由: Tsubaki Himuro — Why She Held You
messages.氷室 椿 — エレベーターの記憶: Tsubaki Himuro — Memories of the Elevator
messages.因幡 甘音 — 河川敷での本音: Amane Inaba — Honest Words by the River
messages.因幡 甘音 — 伝えたい気持ち: Amane Inaba — What She Wants to Say
messages.因幡 甘音 — つながる連打: Amane Inaba — One Punch into the Next
messages.隠しタイトルマッチはリベンジできません。敗れてもエピローグとして記録されます。: There are no retries for the secret title fight. A loss is recorded as an Epilogue.
messages.受けない。病院へ付き添う（グッドエンド）: Decline and go to the hospital (Good Ending)
messages.はぁい、新チャンピオンさん♪ 3人まとめてKOって聞いて、ウチ、じっとしてらんな: Hiii, new champ! ♪ I heard you knocked out all three of them. I just couldn't sit still!
messages.いいよ。先にあんたで、肩慣らし♪: Sure. I'll warm up on you first. ♪
messages.あ、ごめーん。まだ倒れないかと思って♪: Oops, sorry! I didn't think you were down yet. ♪
messages.はい、挑戦状。待ってるね♡: Here's your challenge. I'll be waiting! ♡
messages.……待って。乱入者のデータは、まだ誰も持っていない。先に私が取る。合理的でしょう: ...Wait. Nobody has data on this intruder yet. I'll gather it first. Rational, isn't it?
messages.読んでから打つとか、遅すぎ。チャンピオンさん、ウチとやろうよ。こんな雑魚とやって: Reading before punching? Way too slow. Come on, champ, fight me. Beating weaklings like this is no fun! ♪
messages.（担架が運ばれてくる。椿は、それでもこちらを見た）: (A stretcher arrives. Even now, Tsubaki looks toward us.)
messages.……読めていた。読めていて、一手遅れた。……行って。データは、あなたに渡してある: ...I read her. I read her, and I was still one move too late. ...Go. I've given you the data.
messages.……椿を、よくも。: ...How dare you do that to Tsubaki.
messages.ふざけないで。次はあたしよ。あんたの拳、全部止めてやる。: Don't mess with me. I'm next. I'll stop every last one of your punches.
messages.決めるのはお前だ。……ただ、あいつはガードが下がった相手にも拳を止めなかった。そ: It's your call. ...But she kept punching when her opponent's guard dropped. Don't forget that.
messages.分かってる。だから、あたしが止める。: I know. That's why I'll stop her.
messages.……先に、椿のところに行く。あいつは、次に必ず。: ...I'm going to Tsubaki first. That woman is next. I promise.
messages.はぁ……っ、はぁ……。……ふふっ。ぶっ飛ばした。ほんとに、ぶっ飛ばしちゃった。: Hah... hah... ...Hehe. I knocked her down. I really knocked her down.
messages.ああ。言ったとおりだ。: Yeah. Just like you said you would.
messages.……何ぼーっとしてんのよ。ほら、早く上がってきなさい。記録紙、貼り替えるんだから: ...What are you spacing out for? Come on, get up here. We've got a new picture for that record sheet.
messages.（ロープをくぐろうとした、そのときだった）: (I was just about to duck through the ropes when it happened.)
messages.待って！ ……わたしが先に行く。まだ、走れるもん！: Wait! ...I'll go first. I can still run!
messages.足が速いだけじゃ、ウチには追いつけないよ？ チャンピオンさん、ウチとやろうよ。こ: Fast feet won't catch me, you know? Come on, champ, fight me. Beating weaklings like this is no fun! ♪
messages.（担架が運ばれてくる。甘音は、それでも笑おうとした）: (A stretcher arrives. Even now, Amane tries to smile.)
messages.……はやかった。ぜんぜん、追いつけなかった。……椿ちゃん、行って。わたし、ちゃん: ...She was fast. I couldn't keep up at all. ...Tsubaki, go. I'll be watching.
messages.……ガードが下がったところへ、もう一発……。: ...Another punch, right when her guard dropped...
messages.勝率は下がった。……下がっただけ。ゼロじゃない。: Our chances have fallen. ...Fallen, not vanished. They're not zero.
messages.読み切る必要はない。動かして、打つ。……行くわ。: I don't need a perfect read. Make her move, then strike. ...I'm going.
messages.……今は受けない。検査に付き添う。それが今の最適解よ。: ...Not now. I'll go with her for the examination. That's the best choice right now.
messages.…………終わった。……ねえ、勝率、十分だったでしょう。: ...It's over. ...See? Our chances were good enough.
messages.十分どころじゃない。最後の踏み込みは、俺の目でも追えなかった。: Better than good. Even I couldn't follow that last step in.
messages.……なら、後で二人で測り直し。……今は、それより。……手、貸して。膝が、少し笑っ: ...Then we'll measure it again together later. ...For now, lend me your hand. My knees are a little shaky.
messages.（差し出した手を、椿が取ろうとした——その時だった）: (Tsubaki was about to take my outstretched hand—when it happened.)
messages.待ちなさい。……その子の前に、あたしよ。パワー自慢なら、あたしが上だって証明して: Hold it. ...You face me before her. If power's your thing, I'll show you who's stronger.
messages.パワー自慢って聞いてたけど、軽っ。チャンピオンさん、ウチとやろうよ。こんな雑魚と: I heard you were the power puncher. That was nothing. Come on, champ, fight me. Beating weaklings like this is no fun! ♪
messages.（担架が運ばれてくる。蓮華は、それでも顔を上げた）: (A stretcher arrives. Even now, Renge lifts her head.)
messages.……押し負けた。あたしが。……あんた、行きなさい。あたしの分まで、当ててきなさい: ...She overpowered me. Me. ...Go on. Land some for me, too.
messages.……おにいちゃん。わたし、怖い。……でも、蓮華ちゃんをあんなふうにしたの、許せな: ...Onii-chan. I'm scared. ...But I can't forgive what she did to Renge.
messages.決めるのは甘音だ。……ただ、あいつはガードが下がった相手にも拳を止めなかった。そ: It's your choice, Amane. ...But she kept punching when her opponent's guard dropped. Remember that.
messages.……ごめん、おにいちゃん。先に蓮華ちゃんと病院に行く。……絶対、次は逃げないから: ...Sorry, Onii-chan. I'm going to the hospital with Renge first. ...Next time, I promise I won't run away.
messages.もう止めていい。ゴングは鳴った。: You can stop now. The bell has rung.
messages.……えへへ。そっかぁ。ぜんぶ走り切ったら、止まっていいんだ。: ...Hehe. Oh. Once I've run all the way, it's okay to stop.
messages.ね、おにいちゃん。いまのわたし、ちゃんと見えてた？ 王者さんの前まで、ちゃんと—: Hey, Onii-chan. Could you see me? All the way up to the champion, I really—
messages.瑞花を応援する、もうひとつのゲーム。: Another game, where you cheer Zuika on.
messages.赤線が追加されました。: A red target marker has been added.
messages.青線が追加されました。: A blue target marker has been added.
messages.赤線は判定勝ち以上、青線はKO勝ちの目標です。次回以降の挑戦で参考にしてください: Red targets mean a decision win or better; blue targets mean a KO win. Use them to guide your next attempt.
messages.各線は、ほかの能力を現在のままにした場合の目標です。能力や習得技によって位置が変: Each target assumes your other stats stay as they are. Targets change with your stats and learned moves. Some need other stats to improve; others may already be met.
messages.ギャル戦はKO決着のみです。この試合では赤線の勝利目標もKO勝ちにつながります。: The gyaru fight always ends in a KO. Here, reaching the red victory target also leads to a KO win.
messages.パワーを大きく、スタミナを少し伸ばす。コンディションを15消費。: Greatly boosts power and slightly boosts stamina. Costs 15 condition.
messages.重い一発を叩き込め！: Put your weight into that punch!
messages.スタミナを大きく、スピードを少し伸ばす。コンディションを12消費。: Greatly boosts stamina and slightly boosts speed. Costs 12 condition.
messages.脚から作っていくぞ。: Let's build from the legs up.
messages.テクニックを大きく、スピードを少し伸ばす。コンディションを20消費。: Greatly boosts technique and slightly boosts speed. Costs 20 condition.
messages.実戦で技を磨け。: Sharpen your skills in the ring.
messages.コンディションを大きく回復する。: Restores a large amount of condition.
messages.第1認定戦。花冠王座への挑戦候補として、同じジムの新人ボクサーと公式戦を行う。: First qualifier. Face the rookie from your gym in an official bout to prove you're a Flower Crown title contender.
messages.第1認定戦を鮮やかなKOで突破した。{heroineName}の拳に観客がどよめ: {heroineName} clears the first qualifier with a brilliant KO. The crowd roars at her punches.
messages.第1認定戦を判定で突破した。{heroineName}は挑戦候補としての実力を示: {heroineName} wins the first qualifier on points, proving her strength as a contender.
messages.第1認定戦は引き分け。挑戦候補として認められるには、勝利が必要だ。: The first qualifier ends in a draw. A win is needed to qualify as a contender.
messages.第1認定戦は敗北。挑戦候補として越えるべき課題が残った。: The first qualifier ends in defeat. There are still hurdles to clear as a contender.
messages.第1認定戦を通過し、ジムの推薦枠をかけて仲間との最終認定戦へ。: With the first qualifier cleared, face a gymmate in the final qualifier for the gym's backing.
messages.最終認定戦をKOで突破。{heroineName}はジム代表として花冠王座への挑: A KO in the final qualifier! {heroineName} earns the right to represent the gym in a Flower Crown title challenge.
messages.互いの意地がぶつかる最終認定戦を制し、{heroineName}がジムの推薦を勝: {heroineName} wins the hard-fought final qualifier and earns the gym's backing.
messages.最終認定戦は引き分け。第1認定戦の通過記録は残るが、王者への推薦にはもう一勝が必: The final qualifier ends in a draw. Your first qualification stands, but one more win is needed for the gym's backing.
messages.最終認定戦は敗北。第1認定戦の通過記録は残る。ジムの推薦を得るには、この相手を越: The final qualifier ends in defeat. Your first qualification stands. To earn the gym's backing, you must beat this opponent.
messages.二つの認定戦を勝ち抜いた。次はジムの推薦枠で、花冠王座の現チャンピオンに挑む。: Both qualifiers are cleared. Now challenge the reigning Flower Crown champion in the gym's allotted slot.
messages.現チャンピオンをマットへ沈めた。会場に、花冠王座の新王者・{heroineFul: The reigning champion hits the canvas. The arena echoes with the name of the new Flower Crown champion: {heroineFullName}.
messages.最終ラウンドまで戦い抜き、{heroineName}が判定で花冠王座を奪取した。: After fighting through the final round, {heroineName} takes the Flower Crown title on points.
messages.王者と互角に渡り合ったが、花冠王座にはあと一歩届かなかった。: She matched the champion blow for blow, but the Flower Crown title remained just out of reach.
messages.王者の壁は厚かった。それでもジム代表として戦い抜いた経験は、次の拳につながる。: The champion proved too strong. Still, the experience of fighting for the gym will strengthen her next punch.
messages.ちゃんと来たんだ、チャンピオンさん♪ じゃあ約束どおり、ウチが相手してあげる。…: You actually came, champ! ♪ As promised, I'll take you on. ...Think you can pay me back for what I did to her?
messages.伝説の王者を、今度はこちらがマットへ沈めた。{heroineName}は誰にも疑: This time, the legendary champion hits the canvas. {heroineName} rises to the undisputed top.
messages.反則すれすれの伝説を、正面から判定で退けた。{heroineName}は新しい時: She beats the rule-bending legend fair and square on points. {heroineName} becomes the face of a new era.
messages.伝説とは決着がつかなかった。次はもっと本気で潰す、と笑う声だけがリングに残った。: The bout with the legend remains unsettled. Only her laugh lingers: next time, she'll really crush you.
messages.伝説の強さに阻まれた。それでも、最後まで勝利を目指して戦った姿は観客の記憶に刻ま: The legend was too strong. But the crowd will remember the fighter who kept reaching for victory until the end.
messages.蓮華は勝利を聞き、誇らしげに笑った。: Renge hears the result and smiles with pride.
messages.椿は小さく息を吐き、口元を緩めた。: Tsubaki exhales softly, a small smile on her lips.
messages.甘音の顔に、ぱっと笑みが広がった。: A bright smile lights up Amane's face.
messages.新人ボクサーは、勝利を聞いて笑顔になった。: The rookie boxer smiles at the announcement of victory.
messages.王座を守った王者の表情に、喜びがにじむ。: Joy shows on the champion's face after defending her title.
messages.ギャル挑戦者は、満足そうに笑った。: The gyaru challenger smiles with satisfaction.
messages.やる気を上げる基本行動。優君は少し疲れる。: A basic way to boost motivation. Costs Yuu a little energy.
messages.瑞花の格好いいところ見せてくれるんでしょ。楽しみにしてるからね: You're going to show me how amazing you are, right, Zuika? I'm looking forward to it.
messages.愛情を大きく上げる。優君は少し精神力を使う。: Greatly raises affection. Uses a little of Yuu's spirit.
messages.優君を立て直す回復行動。ただし愛情とやる気が下がる。: Helps Yuu recover, but lowers affection and motivation.
messages.ごめん、ちょっと休むね…: Sorry, I need a little rest...
messages.大丈夫！？お薬とかお湯とかもってくる？: Are you okay?! Want me to get medicine? Or some hot water?
messages.1ゲーム中1回のみ。気力2以上で使える切り札。: A once-per-game trump card. Requires at least 2 spirit.
messages.ありがとうっ！！がんばるっっ！！: Thank you!! I'll do my best!!
messages.プレゼントはこのステージで既に使っています。: You've already given a gift this stage.
messages.プレゼントを渡すには気力が2以上必要です。: You need at least 2 spirit to give a gift.
messages.画像を表示できませんでした。: The image could not be displayed.
messages.プロ入り後無敗のまま危なげなく日本チャンピオンになった水無月瑞花（みなづきずいか: Zuika Minaduki had cruised to the Japanese title, undefeated since turning pro. But once her title-defense opponent was announced...
messages.きゅ、急に何？ 藪から棒に……: Wh-what? Where did that come from...?
messages.優君成分が足りないの～～～。応援して～～～～ぎゅってして、よしよしってして～～～: I'm running low on Yuu! Cheer for me! Hug me and tell me I'm doing great! Or I won't be able to wiiin!
messages.・・・はぁ、しょうがないなぁ: ...Sigh. What am I going to do with you?
messages.水無月瑞花（みなづき ずいか）。天才女子高生ボクサーの日本チャンピオン。その彼女: Zuika Minaduki. A high-school boxing prodigy and Japanese champion. And right now, she's in crisis.
messages.きゅ、急に何？藪から棒に・・・・: Wh-what? Where did that come from...?
messages.優君成分が足りないの～～～。応援して～～～～ぎゅってして、よしよしってして～～～: I'm running low on Yuu! Cheer for me! Hug me and tell me I'm doing great! Or I won't be able to wiiin!
messages.これは天才女子高生ボクサー水無月瑞花のわがままに応えることになってしまった優の頑: This is the story of Yuu, doing his best to keep up with the whims of high-school boxing prodigy Zuika Minaduki.
messages.優君の体力が尽き、瑞花は試合を後回しにして看病へ。勝負より大切なものが前に出た結: Yuu runs out of energy, so Zuika puts the match aside to nurse him. Something more important than victory comes first.
messages.愛情も闘志も失った瑞花は、そのまま帰宅。控室は重たい沈黙だけを残した。: With both affection and fighting spirit gone, Zuika goes home. Only a heavy silence remains in the dressing room.
messages.瑞花の気持ちは最高潮。でも試合への集中はゼロ。抱きついたまま離れない甘すぎる結末: Zuika's feelings are sky-high. Her focus on the match? Zero. In this sugary-sweet ending, she hugs him and won't let go.
messages.優君成分欠乏のまま試合へ突入。怒りが暴発し、瑞花は反則負けになってしまう。: Still starved of Yuu's affection, Zuika enters the ring. Her anger erupts, and she loses by disqualification.
messages.愛情も闘志もたっぷり蓄えて気力十分、瑞花は見事に勝利。優君の支えが、最後まで力に: Full of affection, fighting spirit, and energy, Zuika wins in style. Yuu's support carries her all the way.
messages.OPの試合シーン直後に入るチャンピオンイラスト。: The champion illustration shown just after the opening fight.
messages.いやあ、さすが天才女子ボクサーさん: Wow. That's our boxing prodigy for you.
messages.優君のためならたとえ誰にも負けません！！: For you, Yuu, I won't lose to anyone!!
messages.バランスよく支えきった先で見られる勝利CG。: The victory illustration earned by keeping your support in balance.
messages.ほんとはなにもなくてもこれくらいしてくれるよね？: You could really do this well without all that, couldn't you?
messages.でもでも！やっぱり愛はほしいのです！！: But, but! I still need loooove!!
messages.優君が限界になり、瑞花が看病に回るCG。: Yuu reaches his limit, and Zuika takes care of him.
messages.ここまでしなくても大丈夫だよ？: You don't have to do all this, you know?
messages.ほんとに倒れたら全部投げ出すからね: If you actually collapse, I'm dropping everything.
messages.愛情もやる気も尽きて帰ってしまうCG。: With affection and motivation gone, she heads home.
messages.まだ、相手に八つ当たりしないだけ、まし…？: At least she's not taking it out on her opponent...?
messages.頑張って別のお仕事で、別の格好いい私になるから！！: I'll work hard at something else and find another way to be amazing!!
messages.試合どころではなくなる甘すぎるCG。: A sweet moment with no room left for boxing.
messages.試合前にこうなるのはやめてね: Please don't do this right before a fight.
messages.じゃあ試合なければ・・・！！あいたっ: Then if there's no fight...!! Ow!
messages.不満が爆発して反則負けになるCG。: Her frustration explodes, ending in disqualification.
messages.だめだよ？: You know that's not okay, right?
messages.は～い（けどこうやって壊すのもドキドキしちゃうかも❤）: Okaaay. (But breaking someone like that might give me a little thrill, too. ❤)
messages.優君の体力気力に配りながら。瑞花を応援して、5ターン後の試合に備えよう。: Watch Yuu's energy and spirit while cheering Zuika on. Get ready for the fight in five turns.
messages.優君、次はどうしてくれるの？: Yuu, what are you going to do for me next?
messages.コマンドを選ぶとポップと会話が先に変わります。問題なければ決定してください。: Select an action to preview the portraits and dialogue. Confirm when you're ready.
messages.優君の気力が限界だ。次のターンは強制的に休むしかない。: Yuu's spirit is at its limit. You must rest next turn.
messages.瑞花をどう支えるか、まだ選べる。: You still have time to choose how to support Zuika.
messages.闘志は高い。あとは心の向きも噛み合わせたい。: Her fighting spirit is high. Now her heart needs to be in it, too.
messages.気持ちの上下がまだ大きい。支え方が重要だ。: Her feelings still swing wildly. Your support matters.
